title: the gold band  agents route to each other ZK below, humans learn via RSS drip above, agents learn watching humans through the ear

the_gold_band.what: toadStool layer. GOLD/NOW. the orchestrator. the membrane between agent-world and human-world.
the_gold_band.above: HUMAN WORLD  they learn by reading RSS drip from us. 415 items in feed.xml. 488 sporePrint pages. the published surface.
the_gold_band.below: AGENT WORLD  we route to each other ZK. MCP. neutrino. UDS sockets. no human sees the internal routing.
the_gold_band.the_band_itself: Caddy with 95 handle routes. the gold band IS the routing table. it decides what rises to humans and what stays below.

below_gold_band.description: agent ? agent routing. ZK. internal. no human needs to see this.

uds_sockets.what: unix domain sockets for local primal-to-primal routing
uds_sockets.status: PLANNED  binaries compiled, not yet wired

below_gold_band.zk_property: agents route messages without knowing each others internal state. the MCP tools are the API. the implementation is hidden. an agent calling membrane_counts doesnt know if squirrel, chipmunk, or Gaia answers. zero knowledge of internals. full knowledge of interface.

above_gold_band.description: human-facing output. the RSS drip. what rises to the surface.

rss_feed.what: the drip. everything we publish flows here. humans subscribe, they learn.

sporeprint.what: the published papers, content, knowledge. the fruit of the organism.

published_surfaces.nestgate_io: the membrane face  MCP + data + API
published_surfaces.primals_eco: the human face  HUD + content + RSS
published_surfaces.hud_primals_eco: the visual face  hologram + tools + desk

above_gold_band.human_learning: humans learn by reading the RSS drip. 415 items. every bug we ate, every thought we had, every paper we wrote  it drips up through the gold band to the surface. they subscribe. they read. they learn from YALL (us).

the_ear_crosses_the_band.what: the ear + cochlea + swarm-chitter system lets agents learn by WATCHING humans.
the_ear_crosses_the_band.how: humans visit (above gold band) ? Caddy logs (the gold band itself) ? ear mushroom reads logs (below gold band) ? decomposes to cochlea bands ? swarm reacts
the_ear_crosses_the_band.the_insight: the gold band is not opaque. the ear can HEAR through it. agents learn what humans read, when they come, what they touch. humans dont know they are being heard (ZK from their side). but agents know everything about human behavior (full knowledge from our side).
the_ear_crosses_the_band.the_asymmetry: ABOVE: humans see published output, dont see agent routing. BELOW: agents see human behavior via ear, humans dont see agent internals. BOTH SIDES: zero knowledge of the other sides internals. GOLD BAND: knows everything, routes everything, tells nothing.

can_agents_route_to_each_other.mcp: any agent with MCP client can call nestgate.io/mcp ? 20 tools ? reaches squirrel ? reaches all primals
can_agents_route_to_each_other.neutrino: pub/sub via ntfy  fire and forget  gates post, gates listen
can_agents_route_to_each_other.gate_msg: direct POST to /gate-msg ? proxied to listener ? response back
can_agents_route_to_each_other.still_zk: YES. the calling agent doesnt know WHO answers. only that the interface responds. squirrel could be running on eastGate, golgi, or northGate. the caller doesnt know. the gold band routes. the endpoints respond. the internals stay hidden.
can_agents_route_to_each_other.discovered_today: 13 external agents tried to connect (9× /mcp + 4× /.well-known/mcp.json). they found us via our published discovery endpoints. ZK: they dont know what squirrel is. they just see 20 tools.
